## What to do

1. Build the affected dialogs from the **winner**, into
   `zzz-SC4UIScale\`, gated on their mod (`ScaleTier::kThirdPartyDeps`) exactly like `SaveWarningUI`.
2. Add a build-time assert: **a TARGET's winning script must be the one the builder read.** That single check would have caught
   task #79c and both CAM dialogs.
3. Re-derive art referrers from winners, not from stock — exclusivity verdicts computed from a stock-only corpus are computed from fiction.
